name: displace_vwma15_075r_10to11_k2p0

source.title: Displacement entry, stop at the displacement candle's extreme, 1:1

entry.words: In the New York morning (10:00-11:00 ET), a 15-minute candle whose body is at least 2.0 x ATR(14) of the 14 candles before it is a displacement. Enter at the close in its direction, only long above the 20-bar volume-weighted moving average of 15-minute bars and short below it. Stop at the displacement candle's other extreme (low for a long, high for a short), target 0.75R (1:0.75). One trade a day.

taught: [owner] displacement = body >= k x ATR(14) of prior candles
[owner] stop = the displacement candle's extreme; target 0.75R (1:0.75); 09:30-11:00; one trade a day
not_run: A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
